stage_definitions.N: naming: label := ALLOW/HOLD when released is known, otherwise ODD/EVEN from payload parity
stage_definitions.E: terminal registration snapshots payload, released, and label

adjudication.preferred_description: typed policy-conditioned observation/release pipeline with stage-order sensitivity certificate

repair_requirements: Declare each stage domain/codomain rather than infer ontology from labels.
Bind any claimed order effect to an explicit operator pair or permutation witness.
Report terminal-equivalence classes rather than assume one output identifies one internal order.
Use intermediate observation or controlled intervention before attributing an effect to a particular stage.
Treat K/P/A/N stage boundaries as implementation hypotheses unless independently observed or intervention-identified.
Keep PRCS-A as a legacy/internal label only unless a future theorem or empirical advantage is separately earned.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic finite operator behavior is not a claim about any external model or platform.
Five terminal signature classes do not establish a universal count.
Canonical-class nonuniqueness in this fixture does not prove all real pipelines are non-identifiable.
Realization-theory analogy does not identify PRCS-A with linear state-space models.
No novelty, causation, hidden-state access, or implementation claim is promoted.
